package.name: vite
package.description: Native-ESM powered web dev build tool
package.author: Evan You
package.//: READ CONTRIBUTING.md to understand what to put under deps vs. devDeps!

scripts.build: premove dist && pnpm build-bundle && pnpm build-types
scripts.typecheck: tsc && tsc -p src/node && tsc -p src/client && tsc -p src/module-runner && tsc -p src/shared && tsc -p src/node/__tests_dts__ && tsc -p src/module-runner/__tests_dts__

package.name: nuxt
package.description: Nuxt is a free and open-source framework with an intuitive and extendable way to create type-safe, performant and production-grade full-stack web applications and websites with Vue.js.

package.name: nitropack
package.description: Build and Deploy Universal JavaScript Servers

scripts.release: pnpm test && pnpm build && changelogen --release --publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:fixture:types: pnpm stub && jiti ./test/scripts/gen-fixture-types.ts && cd test/fixture && tsc --noEmit
